release.description: Installation directory refactored to /opt/stealer; Windows migration
release.action: Refactored Unix shell script (src/main/sh/stealer) to use a self-relative path approach: SCRIPT_DIR is derived from dirname of the executed script, STEALER_HOME is its parent. The classpath now includes all JARs in the lib/ directory (lib/*) instead of only java-stealer-*.jar, which previously left all transitive dependency JARs unused at runtime.

Changed FHS installation package name from setmy.info to stealer. Installation path is now /opt/stealer with bin/ and lib/ subdirectories (FHS 3.0 compliant). Previously, all dependency JARs were placed in the shared /opt/setmy.info/lib directory, causing potential classpath conflicts with other applications sharing that directory. The dedicated /opt/stealer/lib/ directory isolates stealer JARs.

Windows migration: src/main/cmd/stealer.cmd uses %~dp0 to determine the script directory and constructs the classpath as %SCRIPT_DIR%..\lib\* to include all dependency JARs from the lib/ directory relative to the installation root. This supports installation at C:\pub\stealer\ with bin\ and lib\ subdirectories. The Maven assembly (src/main/assembly/cli.xml) bundles stealer.cmd into the bin/ directory of the distribution archive alongside the Unix shell script.
